speaker: clown
line: [excited] Hear ye, hear ye! By order of Duke Prospero, the Royal Ball of the Fruit Bowl begins!
note: Play the fanfare sound effect before it; [fanfare] is not a voice tag

speaker: clown
line: Present your seal at the gate, and take your place on the Prince's Privy Council.

speaker: clown
line: Behold Prince Hamlet, the first prince whose entire mind has been mapped. Every one of his hundred and sixty-six thousand neurons.

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Helmsman! Left and right are yours.

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Liftmaster! You hold the heights.

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Wingmaster! Forward, and mind the brakes.

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Seer! You alone can sense the Princess, and the Giant. Speak up.

speaker: clown
line: Four grapes for the royal banquet. Surely an entire council can manage breakfast.

speaker: clown
line: Wingmaster: forward gently. Release to slow. The grape is not fleeing.

speaker: clown
line: Helmsman: left and right. Small corrections; we are gardening, not invading.

speaker: clown
line: Liftmaster: up for the grape, down for the chalice. Keep the crown attached.

speaker: clown
line: Together now. Slow before the turn; the chalice has suffered enough.

speaker: clown
line: Seer: find Miranda beside the chalice. Tell your council which way to fly.

speaker: clown
line: Four delivered! Responsibility has never looked so purple.

speaker: clown
line: Tonight, Prospero would announce Hamlet and Miranda's intended marriage. First: one tiny royal errand.

speaker: hamlet
line: Four grapes. Delivered with princely precision.

speaker: clown
line: And not a drop tasted.

speaker: hamlet
line: Perfectly under—oh.

speaker: clown
line: Innocence, unfortunately, does not remove grape stains.

speaker: prospero
line: [indignant] Grape-stained lips? Swaying beside the banquet cup? Hamlet!

speaker: hamlet
line: A landing accident, Your Grace. An extremely purple one.

speaker: prospero
line: [angry] Tonight I must trust you beside my daughter. You cannot even arrive at breakfast with your judgment intact?

speaker: hamlet
line: [desperately] I haven't drunk anything! Ask the council!

speaker: prospero
line: Then show me the judgment your appearance has failed to demonstrate. The announcement is suspended.

speaker: prospero
line: Stay outside until you can conduct yourself.

speaker: clown
line: A royal misunderstanding. Naturally, nobody listened to the useful witnesses.

speaker: hamlet
line: A window. Council, we can still explain.

speaker: clown
line: Provided the window has fewer opinions than the door.

speaker: tinman
line: [smugly] Locked out of your own announcement? Bold entrance, Hamlet.

speaker: tinman
line: [amused] My window, my little test of judgment. Answer well: pear nectar. Answer poorly: the grape cordial you appear to favor.

speaker: hamlet
line: Council, help me answer.

speaker: tinman
line: Take your time. Composure cannot be hurried.

speaker: clown
line: Alcohol can make balance and coordination... A: worse. B: more precise.
note: Reads the question card aloud; the options stay on screen

speaker: clown
line: Alcohol can interfere with the brain functions used for balance and coordinated movement.
note: Plays after the answer, before the drink panel. Correct answer: A

speaker: tinman
line: A correct answer. How inconvenient for my first impression. Pear nectar, as promised.

speaker: tinman
line: A charming answer. Entirely wrong. Grape cordial, as agreed.

speaker: clown
line: And now the misunderstanding has acquired a sequel.

speaker: tinman
line: Do try not to arrive in pieces. Miranda dislikes a scene.

speaker: clown
line: Below the window: storage. Below the storage: trouble.

speaker: clown
line: An excellent inspection of the masonry. Let us try the opening.

speaker: rutabaga
line: [nervously] Oh! A person. Was I coming downstairs or escaping them? Never mind. You look... scheduled.

speaker: rutabaga
line: I wrote a question to remember which drink to offer. Or whom to offer it to. Could you help?

speaker: hamlet
line: We need the stairs.

speaker: rutabaga
line: Yes! Those. Of course. A quick test, then I'll stop occupying them.

speaker: clown
line: Can heavy drinking interfere with forming new memories? A: No. B: Yes.
note: Reads the question card aloud; the options stay on screen

speaker: clown
line: Alcohol can disrupt the formation of new memories. That is not the same as magically deleting every old memory.

speaker: rutabaga
line: [excited] Yes! New memories. I knew that was important. Pear nectar for the person who remembered.

speaker: rutabaga
line: My card says otherwise. That means the purple one. I think the card is more organized than either of us.

speaker: rutabaga
line: [startled] I remember why I came down! Goodbye!
note: A heavy groan and THUD above first (sound effect, nondirectional)

speaker: hamlet
line: What was that?

speaker: clown
line: A sensible question. Naturally, we went upstairs to investigate it personally.

speaker: clown
line: One minute before Prospero's inner gate closes. Quiet wings, council. Quiet wings!

speaker: clown
line: The gate beat you to the banquet. Once more, with quieter confidence.

speaker: cheapdate
line: [hiccups] Hamlet! Excellent. I have two drinks and almost enough hands.

speaker: cheapdate
line: Before you enter, a toast. Pass my little test and take the pear. Fail, and share my purple vintage.

speaker: cheapdate
line: A question of recovery. A subject on which I have conducted extensive, regrettable research.

speaker: clown
line: Does coffee remove alcohol's effects on judgment and coordination? A: Yes. B: No.
note: Reads the question card aloud; the options stay on screen

speaker: clown
line: Feeling more awake does not remove those impairing effects.

speaker: cheapdate
line: No? Coffee doesn't fix it? That explains several breakfasts. Pear nectar it is.

speaker: cheapdate
line: Wrong, apparently. Clown wrote the answer on my sleeve. Purple for you; humility for neither of us.

speaker: clown
line: [shouting] Cheapdate! Your chair is in the punch bowl again!

speaker: cheapdate
line: My seat has arrived before me!

speaker: hamlet
line: At last—
note: Cut off by the crash sound effect

speaker: clown
line: A sentence the evening declined to let him finish.

speaker: clown
line: The Giant had arrived. It had neither invitation nor table manners.

speaker: prospero
line: [alarmed] You? I told you to stay outside!

speaker: hamlet
line: The garden wasn't what it looked like. Please, let me explain.

speaker: prospero
line: Then show me. Keep its attention. Outlast its swats until it abandons this hall.

speaker: hamlet
line: Council, together. We don't have to hurt it. We have to stay out of reach.

speaker: clown
line: Ten dodges. One very large temper. Let us test which lasts longer.
note: The objective text is on screen only, not voiced

speaker: clown
line: Ten swats survived. The Giant departed to find something less organized to squash.

speaker: prospero
line: You stood your ground by refusing to stay in one place. Well flown, Hamlet.

speaker: miranda
line: [relieved] You're safe. Next time, find me before volunteering for the hand.

speaker: hamlet
line: Next time, I'm delivering flowers.

speaker: prospero
line: [furious] First the garden. Now this. Stand back.

speaker: clown
line: Prospero finished the task himself—and returned with considerably less patience than he left with.

speaker: prospero
line: You expect my blessing after this? You will not pass me.

speaker: hamlet
line: Then let Miranda speak for herself.

speaker: clown
line: His Grace's next argument was regrettably acidic.
note: The objective text is on screen only, not voiced

speaker: miranda
line: Father, thank him. Then listen to him.

speaker: miranda
line: [firmly] Enough, Father! I love Hamlet. You do not get to spit at the person I choose.

speaker: clown
line: For the record: he was delivering my grapes. The chalice splashed him. I was there.

speaker: prospero
line: [softly] Then I judged before I listened. Miranda—do you still wish the announcement to go ahead?

speaker: miranda
line: Yes. Because I choose it.

speaker: prospero
line: Then let the banquet begin again.

speaker: clown
line: A royal announcement, approved by Miranda. The grapes abstained.

speaker: clown
line: Hamlet's evening had reached the floor. The competition mistook this for a promotion.

speaker: tinman
line: [smugly] A more composed candidate stands before you.

speaker: cheapdate
line: [hiccups] And one behind him!

speaker: rutabaga
line: [confused] Which position am I applying for?

speaker: miranda
line: [firmly] Enough. I never wanted a marriage chosen for me. Not by a contest. Not by any of you.

speaker: miranda
line: I can decide my own future.

speaker: clown
line: For once, the entire court had nothing useful to add. It was a peaceful ending.

speaker: clown
line: Dizziness increased: allow more room to stop.
note: After a wrong answer raises dizziness; optional voice, the notice is on screen

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Helmsman has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Liftmaster has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Wingmaster has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

speaker: clown
line: The Royal Seer has fainted! Revive them, quickly!

speaker: clown
line: [gasps] A changeling! The same neurons, but scrambled within. Let us see how the Seer fares now.

speaker: clown
line: The true Prince returns.

speaker: clown
line: By royal decree: his wiring is real. Everything else, we will tell you.

speaker: clown
line: The changeling had the very same neurons as our Prince. [laughs] Its Seer still could not find a princess in a banquet hall.

speaker: clown
line: A fine effort, my lords and ladies. Mostly fine. Partly effort.

speaker: clown
line: The court will remember this trial. The court will try to forget it.
